confirmed_source_proof: Compiled src/do_name.c:1485-1493 retains the original upstream display-RNG selection/rejection loop and exactly one original pmname call. The assignment remembers that existing return; selected_random receives the same &mons[name] and exact name pointer.

Compiled src/do_name.c:994-1000 calls rndmonnam once, appends its exact public result, then gives only that result to nh_text_monster_nested. No mtmp, mdat or nh_visible is passed to this nested random identity hook.

src/nh-semantic-name.c:117-133 validates selected == &mons[index] and selected->pmnames[gender] == public_name. pmidx is an internal generated-table selector; no numeric index or pointer is emitted. Ambiguous pooled labels fail closed.
src/nh-semantic-name.c:821-837 and994-1001 produce the public selected label. Exact bounded byte checks certify the observed assembly; no ID is guessed by searching completed English.

src/nh-semantic-name.c:892-940 snapshots an exact live registry event and requires original prefix/body/article bytes to match. It emits only the already-public original and selected descriptor plus original public qualifiers.

rndmonnam:1480 invalidates its static-buffer range before selection. The bogusmon branch at1489-1490 has no semantic hook; unregistered names therefore have no qualified nested body and finish remains NULL.
src/lock.c:573-574 preserves the upstream format and mon_nam(mtmp) argument. Original native command, naming, RNG and public prefix/article behavior were not changed by this review.
All three relevant compiled source hashes match the actual engine compiled_input_hashes and executed R2 config; the public label header hash matches the actual compiled_header_hashes.

dual_acceptance_contract.nonnull: Require exact lock ID/source ownership, exact supported composite/composite/label typed-union shape, compiled public label membership, EN integrity equality to the captured public original, exact existing JA template result and exact history wire. Malformed or unsupported nonnull envelopes fail.
dual_acceptance_contract.null: Require complete exact original C English fallback in EN and JA, no invented descriptor, no semantic ID, and upstream-english status.
dual_acceptance_contract.both: Keep registered-only first paints and full100 history/DOM/fallback/input/world/RNG invariance; ended-game history must preserve the exact independently verified branch text/id/status.
dual_acceptance_contract.privacy_caveat: A legal random draw may itself select kitten. Absence of the earlier known-pet ID is an observed fixture fact, not the general privacy proof. Source-certified same public random selection is the general rule.
dual_acceptance_contract.coverage: Only the observed public-random branch or observed NULL branch may be marked verified. No blanket all-hallucination, bogus-name, full-campaign, encyclopedia or full-Japanese proof follows.
